title: 稳压电源：恒压、恒流和限流
summary: 稳压电源有两个旋钮：电压和限流。负载要的电流没到限流值时恒压（CV），到了就恒流（CC）——可以当电流源用。
concepts: bench power supply 稳压电源
description: 直流稳压电源有两个设定值：电压设定是输出电压的上限，限流设定是输出电流的上限。负载想要的电流 V/R 小于限流值时，电源输出设定电压（CV）；超过限流值时，电源把电流卡在限流值，电压自己降到 I × R（CC）。电路：稳压电源 → R1 → GND。

cards.title: 把限流调小，看电压掉下来
text: 接一个电阻当负载，先看电源屏幕。然后**把限流旋钮调到比负载要的电流还小**——屏幕上的电压会怎样？

cards.title: 两个旋钮都是“上限”
text: - **电压旋钮**：输出电压最多到这里。**限流旋钮**：输出电流最多到这里。
- 负载想要的电流 $\frac{V}{R}$ 没到限流值：电源输出设定电压，显示 **CV**（恒压，绿色）。
- 负载想要的电流超过限流值：电源把电流**卡在限流值**，电压自己降到 $I \times R$，显示 **CC**（恒流，红色）。
![](fig:cvcc)
- 屏幕上大字是**实际输出**，下面一行小字是**旋钮位置**。设定值不等于实际值——这是新手最常看错的地方。

cards.title: 把它当成电流源
text: 限流调到想要的电流，电压设定调高一些留出余量：不管负载怎么变，电流都不变，变的是电压。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **CV：电压是你定的，电流由负载决定。CC：电流是你定的，电压由负载决定。**
- 调试新电路：先把限流设小（50–100 mA），接错了电源会进入 CC，元件就安全。
- 真实电源常用的设限流方法：先把输出端短路，看着电流表调限流旋钮，再拆掉短路线接负载。

caption.text: 电源的输出被两条线围住：电压不超过 V_set，电流不超过 I_limit。负载电阻大，工作点落在横线上（CV）；电阻小，落在竖线上（CC），电压被迫降下来。

i18n.en: The output is fenced in by two lines: voltage up to V_set, current up to I_limit. A large load resistance lands on the horizontal line (CV); a small one lands on the vertical line (CC) and the voltage is forced down.

en.title: Bench supply: constant voltage, constant current, current limit
en.summary: A bench supply has two knobs: voltage and current limit. Below the limit it holds the voltage (CV); at the limit it holds the current (CC) — so it doubles as a current source.
en.description: A DC bench supply has two settings: the voltage setting is the most voltage it will output and the current limit the most current. When the current the load wants, V/R, is below the limit, the supply outputs the set voltage (CV); above it, the supply holds the current at the limit and the voltage drops to I × R by itself (CC). Circuit: bench supply → R1 → GND.
steps: Pick **Bench power supply**: red clip (+) on **`tp1`**, black clip (−) on **`tn1`**.
Look at the display: with no load the current is 0 and green **CV** means constant voltage; the line below shows the two knobs. Keep **5 V** and a **100 mA** limit in Properties for now.
**Jumper** **`c5`** → **`tn5`**: R1 goes to GND. The display: about 23 mA, still CV — the load wants less than the 100 mA limit.
Click the supply and turn the **current limit** down to **10 mA** in Properties. It turns red **CC**: the current is held at 10 mA and the voltage has dropped.
**Current source**: click R1 and change it to **`470 Ω`**. Still CC: still 10 mA, and the voltage moved with the load.

Click the supply and set the **voltage** to **12 V**. The actual voltage on the display does not move at all: still CC, the set voltage is only a ceiling. That headroom lets it hold 10 mA into a bigger load too.
Press **Check my circuit** and read the supply's display for the questions (some need the limit changed first — the state each one needs is written under it).
hints: Decide the mode first: compare the current the load wants, V(set) / R, with the limit. Which is smaller?
In CC the current is the limit and the voltage is I × R; in CV the voltage is the setting and the current is V / R.
With a 10 mA limit, the voltage on 220 Ω and on 470 Ω is 10 mA times each.
tests: Current-limit mode: the current equals the limit setting

measurements.ask: The current on the supply's display (CC mode, R1 = 470 Ω)
measurements.explain: In CC mode the current is the limit setting.

measurements.ask: The voltage on the supply's display (same state). It is set to 12 V — what is it actually?
measurements.explain: V = I × R = 10 mA × 470 Ω = 4.70 V: the load decides the voltage; 12 V is only the ceiling.

measurements.ask: Turn the limit up to 20 mA (voltage still set to 12 V): the voltage on the supply's display
measurements.explain: 12 V / 470 Ω ≈ 25.5 mA is still above 20 mA, so still CC: V = 20 mA × 470 Ω = 9.4 V. The current knob sets the source's current.

measurements.ask: With R1 = 470 Ω, turn the limit back up to 100 mA: the current on the supply's display (see it switch back to CV)
measurements.explain: 12 V / 470 Ω ≈ 25.5 mA, below 100 mA, so CV: the voltage is the setting and the load decides the current.

cards.title: Turn the limit down and watch the voltage drop
text: Use one resistor as the load and look at the supply's display. Then **turn the current limit below what the load wants** — what does the voltage on the display do?

cards.title: Both knobs are limits
text: - **Voltage knob**: the output voltage goes up to here at most. **Current-limit knob**: the output current goes up to here at most.
- The load wants $\frac{V}{R}$, which is below the limit: the supply outputs the set voltage and shows **CV** (constant voltage, green).
- The load wants more than the limit: the supply **holds the current at the limit** and the voltage drops by itself to $I \times R$; it shows **CC** (constant current, red).
![](fig:cvcc)
- The big digits are the **actual output**, the small line below is **where the knobs are**. Setting is not output — the most common beginner mistake.

cards.title: Use it as a current source
text: Set the limit to the current you want and the voltage a bit higher for headroom: whatever the load does, the current stays put and the voltage follows.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **CV: you set the voltage, the load sets the current. CC: you set the current, the load sets the voltage.**
- Debugging a new circuit: set a low limit first (50–100 mA); if something is wired wrong the supply goes into CC and your parts are safe.
- A common way to set a real supply's limit: short its output, adjust the limit knob while watching the current, then remove the short and connect the load.

tests.name: 限流模式：电流等于限流设定

compare:
**对比**：
- 5 V、限流 100 mA、R1 = 220 Ω：想要 5 / 220 ≈ 22.7 mA < 100 mA → CV，显示 5.00 V、0.023 A；
- 限流 10 mA、R1 = 220 Ω：想要 22.7 mA > 10 mA → CC，电压 = 10 mA × 220 Ω = **2.20 V**；
- 设定 12 V、限流 10 mA、R1 = 470 Ω：想要 25.5 mA > 10 mA → 还是 CC，电压 = 10 mA × 470 Ω = **4.70 V**，电流仍是 **10 mA**；
- 限流 20 mA：想要 25.5 mA > 20 mA → 还是 CC，电压 = 20 mA × 470 Ω = **9.4 V**；
- 限流调回 100 mA：想要 25.5 mA < 100 mA → CV，电压 12 V，电流 ≈ **25.5 mA**。
电流源能维持 10 mA 的最大负载是 12 V / 10 mA = 1.2 kΩ；负载再大，电压到顶，电源回到 CV。

measurements.ask: 电源显示的电流（CC 模式，R1 = 470 Ω）
measurements.explain: CC 模式下电流就是限流设定值。

measurements.ask: 电源显示的电压（同一状态）。设定是 12 V，实际是多少？
measurements.explain: V = I × R = 10 mA × 470 Ω = 4.70 V：电压由负载决定，12 V 只是上限。

measurements.ask: 把限流调到 20 mA（电压设定还是 12 V）：电源显示的电压
measurements.explain: 12 V / 470 Ω ≈ 25.5 mA 还是大于 20 mA，所以仍是 CC：V = 20 mA × 470 Ω = 9.4 V。电流源的电流由限流旋钮决定。

measurements.ask: R1 = 470 Ω，把限流调回 100 mA：电源显示的电流（看看它变回了 CV）
measurements.explain: 12 V / 470 Ω ≈ 25.5 mA，小于 100 mA，所以是 CV：电压等于设定值，电流由负载决定。

steps.text: 看屏幕：没接负载时电流是 0，绿色 **CV** 表示恒压；下面一行是两个旋钮的位置。在「属性」里先保持 **5 V**、限流 **100 mA**。
**跳线** **`c5`** → **`tn5`**，R1 接到 GND。看屏幕：电流约 23 mA，还是 CV——负载要的电流没到 100 mA 的限流。
单击电源，在「属性」里把**限流**调到 **10 mA**。指示变成红色 **CC**：电流被卡在 10 mA，电压掉下来了。
**电流源**：单击 R1，把阻值改成 **`470 Ω`**。还是 CC：电流还是 10 mA，电压跟着负载变了。
单击电源，把**电压设定**调到 **12 V**。屏幕上的实际电压一点没变：还在 CC，设定电压只是“上限”。这个余量让负载再大一些它也能维持 10 mA。
点**「检查我的电路」**，读电源屏幕完成测量题（有的题要先调限流，题目下面写着要的“状态”）。

hints: 先判断模式：负载想要的电流 V设定 / R 和限流值比，哪个小？
CC 模式下，电流 = 限流设定，电压由 I × R 决定；CV 模式下，电压 = 设定值，电流由 V / R 决定。
10 mA 限流时，220 Ω 和 470 Ω 上的电压分别是 10 mA 乘以它们。
